title: Client funds upload (BOW front end, BOW_FUND)
when: BOD, 08:13; again in the morning for changed clients
purpose: Each client's funds (user deposit) for BOW (BOLTPlusOnWeb, BSE's front end from MarketPlace Tech), uploaded in the BOW Admin terminal: the file the broker's current back office writes. One line per client, comma-separated, no header, CRLF, 20 fields; the client code and the cash deposit in whole rupees (may be negative, a debit) are the only values, every other field is blank or a constant. It is a user-level deposit (category, exchange and market blank), so it carries ONE figure per client: Securities + Commodities as Ledgerline's BOW limits compute them, a blocked, inactive or not active client 0. The BOW API push (Connections → BOW limits API) is preferred: it sets Securities and Commodities separately, which this file cannot. Ledgerline writes every active client (and 0 once for a client no longer active who was last sent a non-zero figure), or only the clients whose figure changed since the last file (the broker's second, small morning file).

columns.name: Client code
columns.note: The client's UCC (BOW's back-office ID), not the BOW login (CLIENT-T…)

columns.name: Field 2
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file; probably the deposit category (blank = all: user level, EditUserDeposit UDCategory). Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 3
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file; probably the exchange (blank at user level, UDExchange). Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 4
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file; probably the market or segment (blank at user level, UDMarket / UDSEGMENT). Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Cash deposit
columns.note: Funds in whole rupees (not × 10,000 as the API takes them), integer, may be negative (debit); mostly 0. The cash deposit (EditUserDeposit UDAmount1). Ledgerline writes Securities + Commodities (signed: a debit in one ledger reduces the other), rounded down to the rupee; 0 for a blocked, inactive or not active client

columns.name: Field 6
columns.note: Always 0 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. Perhaps the adhoc deposit (UDADHOCMARGIN).

columns.name: Field 7
columns.note: Always 0 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. Perhaps another deposit amount (UDAmount3).

columns.name: Field 8
columns.note: Always 0 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. Perhaps another deposit amount.

columns.name: Field 9
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file; perhaps the valid-till date (UDValidTill). Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 10
columns.note: Always 1 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. Probably the multiplier (UDAmount2, 1 in units rather than × 10,000) or the row state (UDROWSTATE 1 = add).

columns.name: Field 11
columns.note: Always 0 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. Perhaps the MTM factor or the adhoc deposit.

columns.name: Field 12
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file. Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 13
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file. Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 14
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file. Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 15
columns.note: Blank in the broker's file. Meaning unconfirmed

columns.name: Field 16
columns.note: Always 1 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. A flag; perhaps consider adhoc deposit for margin (UDFIELD6 = 1).

columns.name: Field 17
columns.note: Always 1 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. A flag.

columns.name: Field 18
columns.note: Always 0 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. A flag; perhaps consider adhoc deposit for MTM limits (UDFIELD7 = 0).

columns.name: Field 19
columns.note: Always 1 in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. A flag; perhaps the row state (1 = add).

columns.name: Field 20
columns.note: Always Y in the broker's file: observed constant; meaning unconfirmed. Perhaps 'replace the existing deposit' or 'active'.

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW funds file (all clients, or changed only)
source: real BOW upload files from the broker (structure only), 9 Nov 2026; field meanings partly from BOW API v1.0.5
